scientific_integrity: A complete proof is given; finite verifier corroborates rather than replaces infinite-parameter reasoning; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite rectangular chain products to labelled four-world Boolean diamond only; prior-work comparison relies partly on published abstracts where full text was inaccessible.
